Spoken Brazil — tá, tô, a gente & the sound kit

Brazilian Portuguese grammar, chapter 30 of 60 · taught in Lição 20 · level A2. The shortcuts of real speech: tá/tô/pra, a gente + ele-form, cadê, and the social sounds.

What this is about

The gap between textbook Portuguese and what Brazilians actually say is real.

The great shortcuts

estou → tô · está → tá Tô chegando! (I'm on my way — Brazil's favorite text)
para → pra · para o → pro Vou pra casa. Vou pro trabalho.
você → cê (speech only)Cê vai? — heard everywhere, written nowhere
Register rule: say them freely, type them to friends, but keep full forms in anything formal.

a gente — revisited

A gente se vê amanhã! see you tomorrow (lit. we see each other)
A gente vai? · A gente combinou às oito.always the ele/ela verb form — never "a gente vamos"

The social sound kit

né? right? — from não é? Glues onto anything.
beleza? / beleza! all good? / cool! — greeting AND answer
valeu! thanks, man! — casual obrigado
bora! · opa! · falou! let's go! · hey/oops! · later! (ending calls)
Cadê…? where's…? — Cadê todo mundo? (no verb needed)
Oi, sumido! hey stranger! (lit. "hi, vanished one")

Exceptions & details

1 · WhatsApp dialect: blz (beleza), vlw (valeu).
